rights.explanation: Every tenant has the legal right to a home that is safe and fit for human habitation, including basic amenities like water and electricity.
rights.action: If your landlord fails to maintain basic standards, you can give a written notice and, if unresolved, approach the local rent control board.
rights.consult: Consult a lawyer if the landlord tries to evict you forcefully or cuts off essential services.

rights.explanation: Consumers have the right to be informed about the quality, quantity, potency, purity, standard, and price of goods or services.
rights.action: Always check labels, ask for receipts, and compare prices. Use the National Consumer Helpline for grievances.
rights.consult: Consult a lawyer if you suffer significant financial loss or physical harm due to a defective product or service deficiency.

rights.right: Right to know the grounds of arrest
rights.explanation: Any person being arrested has the right to be informed of the specific reason or grounds for their arrest immediately.
rights.action: Ask the police officer clearly why you are being detained. They must show an arrest warrant in non-cognizable cases.
rights.consult: Consult a lawyer immediately after arrest to handle bail and legal representation.
